title: Bram and the Archive
author: Rosalind Iversen
blurb: Tamsin Brightwater, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
